name: tool-authoring-standard
title: Tool Authoring Standard
description: Standardize how scenarios expose LLM-callable tools to agent-inbox (and future conversational surfaces). Proto-first definitions, a shared Go toolkit in packages/ that collapses the current ~100-line-per-tool boilerplate to ~10, a canonical api/tools/ location, a scenario-auditor rule comparing declared tools against the runtime /api/v1/tools endpoint, prompt-manager skills for tool authoring and fleet adoption audits, and a refreshed react-vite + go-api template with a tool stub. No service.json manifest additions — runtime endpoint remains authoritative.
